title: DR1 warns the user that ZIP files are not allowed for security reasons; the frontend never mentions ZIP and simply refuses the file when it is chosen.

finding.frontend: The requirements list has two bullets and neither refers to archives (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/template.njk:43-48). A ZIP is refused, because the accepted set is the eight document and image extensions and nothing else (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/upload-config.js:3-18), but the user only learns that after choosing the file, from the generic type message "The selected file must be a PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, PNG, XLS or XLSX". Why an archive in particular is refused is never explained.
finding.prototype: The fourth bullet of the requirements list reads "ZIP files are not allowed for security reasons" (app/views/upload-documents.html:169). It is on the page before the user opens the file picker, and it gives the reason rather than only the rule. It is visible on dr1-upload-documents and on every error state of the page.
finding.difference: Add the ZIP bullet to the requirements list under "Your file must be:", in DR1's words. This is copy only — the frontend already rejects archives, so no validation changes.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding any statement about ZIP or archive files on the frontend's upload page or in its file-type error message.

relatedTo.why: both are bullets of the same requirements list
